name: Caligni Assassin AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

items.name: Spiked Gauntlet
items.description: Providing the same defensive function as a standard gauntlet, this version has a group of spikes protruding from the knuckles to deliver piercing damage with a punch.

items.name: Throwing Knife
items.description: This light knife is optimally balanced to be thrown accurately at a greater distance than a common dagger. While this comes at the cost of a significant cutting edge, the difference is worth it for throwing specialists.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

generalAbilities.name: Shadow Shift
generalAbilities.description: Caligni assassins are Concealed in dim light or darkness even to creatures that can see clearly in those light levels.

generalAbilities.name: Swift Sneak
generalAbilities.description: The assassin can move their full speed while Sneaking.

defensiveAbilities.name: Countershadow
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 60 feet casts a light spell

Effect The caligni assassin attempts to counteract the triggering spell. Caligni assassins automatically recognize light spells.

defensiveAbilities.name: Death Umbral Shroud
defensiveAbilities.description: When a caligni assassin dies, their body disintegrates into a veil of supernatural darkness for 1 round. A 4th-rank Darkness spell appears, centered on the assassin's location, with a counteract DC of 23.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deny Advantage
defensiveAbilities.description: The assassin isn't Off-Guard to creatures of 8th level or lower that are Hidden, undetected, flanking, or using surprise attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Light Blindness
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

When first exposed to bright light, the monster is Blinded until the end of its next turn. After this exposure, light doesn't blind the monster again until after it spends 1 hour in darkness. However, as long as the monster is in an area of bright light, it's Dazzled.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Draw
offensiveAbilities.description: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion. You Interact to draw a weapon, then Strike with that weapon.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shadow Leap
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The assassin is in dim light or darkness

Effect The assassin vanishes into shadow, appearing in a square of dim light or darkness within 60 feet. If the assassin appears adjacent to a creature, they can Strike that creature, otherwise the assassin can Hide.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The assassin deals an additional 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Umbral Veil
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The assassin's last action was a successful melee Strike

Effect The assassin extends a tendril of shadow to obscure the target's vision, blinding them for 1 round (DC 23 Will Saving Throw negates). On a critical failure, they're blind for 1 minute. Creatures with greater darkvision are immune to this ability.
